name: NICKEL PRATT
note: PRATT AT THE COUNTER (doc 57 D6: 'PRA_D6 option 5; the next time Thad enters the Registrar's, Pratt is at the counter'). Room 7's four image operations are spent, so he is his Prosperity sheet, mallet in hand, as he walked home from D2 -- for Tyler's playthrough. Room 7's arrival scene is the attestation (onEnter.sayLines, from doc 57); once it is read (T_ATTESTED) he walks out of the door.
walkToNote: Beside him along the counter, facing him.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Pratt.

sprite.frameNote: 0 the mallet resting on the ground · 1 breath (derived) · 2 the mallet on his shoulder. Every `breakEvery` seconds he shoulders it (errata 77). Not 3 or 4: there is no stake here.
sprite.statureNote: Tyler, 2026-11-06, after the leaner redraw: "scale wise, he still looks way bigger than Thad. I think his current frame needs to be scaled down to better match Thad." With his hat, his breadth and his mallet he read well over Thad at 1.03. Now 0.96 of the room's man, crown to sole: his hat brings him level with Thad. (Was 1.03: "The bigger man: room-25's master drew him 1.05 of Thad".)
sprite.figureHeightNote: ERRATA 234. Crown to sole, his hat excluded, the crown read from his eyes and chin (content/scale-anchors.json `figures`): 402. Was 386 (tools/art/figure-height.py --hat), which took a row at his eyebrows for the crown and drew him 1.01 of Thad, not the 0.96 Tyler ruled (statureNote). Errata 263: the sheet was redrawn at the cast's proportions (reference/final-look); solved again on the new drawing by tools/solve-figure-height.mjs: 405 (406 at Prosperity, 405 at the Registrar's; 405 keeps the sheet within 5% of the level it was snapped at, and a re-snap broke the mallet's handle from his hands).
sprite.redrawn: Errata 111 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master, cast-unify operation 19 (reference/cast-unify-17.txt), full figure, his mallet in every pose so it never appears or vanishes; cut with its own pixels and a clean edge on his feet; its own file.
sprite.buildNote: LEANER (Tyler, 2026-11-06: "standing next to Thad Pratt look like a much 'thicker' character"; he chose "Leaner, still sturdy"): redrawn in the same poses, an ordinary working man a little broader than Thad (cast-unify 49), cut by tools/art/cast-unify-cut.py; figureHeight is crown to sole, the hat not counted (tools/art/figure-height.py --hat).
sprite.levelManNote: The image session snapped this sheet at 402.0833; drawn at 405 / 0.96 it is 4.9% off its level, inside the 5% tests/one-level.test.mjs holds (errata 263).

exit.note: Doc 57 D6: attested, he goes -- in front of the queue rope, not through it, and out by the street door at the left.
exit.walkNote: WALK-C: six frames posed on Thad's walk, the leaner Pratt (cast-unify 50; Tyler, 2026-11-06: "Pratt's gait is kind of awkward because his knee goes so high" -- briefed with low knees), cut by tools/art/walk-c.py; figureHeight crown to sole on the passing frame, as his standing frames are measured. strideRatio MEASURED FROM THESE FRAMES (R5f), calibrated on Thad's walk.
exit.speedNote: Tyler, 2026-11-06: "His gait is way better though but maybe still weirdly slow." Now 0.7 of his height a second (Thad walks 0.81), 258 px/s at his 0.96 stature. Was half his height a second, Deke's pace. Before that 80 px/s: "Pratt walks so slow it's hard to even figure out if his walk could be good."
exit.doorNote: Tyler, 2026-11-06: "Does Pratt just disappear through a closed door?" -- he walked to the shut street door and vanished in front of it. Asked, Tyler chose "Door opens for him": the door stands open while he crosses the last 320 px to it and goes through, and shuts 0.8 s after. The open doorway (room-07 attempt 5, the plate's left end redrawn with the door open) is fitted into the plate's door frame in perspective by tools/art/room07-door.py. His path now ends in the doorway (96,792), not in front of the shut door (40,820).
